analysis:
Both units are test-only changes to provider-swift/Tests/ProviderCoreTests/Config/ClusterRuntimeApprovalFactsTests.swift: base is the v1 approval-facts tests, head is the v2 schema with pair_serving_grant, parity_qualifications, a decoder with a release-version-bound derived-ID limit, and golden canonical bytes. The head excerpt ends at line 374 (truncated), so the remainder (patch ranges up to ~883) was not visible. No production code, endpoints or runtime controls are changed in the supplied evidence.

The new tests give good negative coverage of the decoder: unknown, missing and mistyped fields, duplicate keys (including escaped), the schema v1 downgrade, zero and uppercase digests, mode-family ordering and uniqueness, cut and envelope bounds, and derived-ID length bounds. These tests check parsing strictness of the approval/qualification facts consumed by the cluster path. That relates to the build-qualification and serving-authorization themes (A-017, T-054), but those are platform-owned, and the production decoder and compute implementations were not supplied.

Open items for integration: (1) The production ClusterRuntimeApprovalFacts decoder, ClusterPublicModels.declared and parityQualifications were not supplied, so the tests' claims about them were not verified. (2) The fixture JSON glm-5.3-flash-dev-branch17.json is not visible. (3) The test fixtures use a shell script stand-in for the worker; this does not affect production. Nothing here weakens a threat-model control, and no regression is identified from the visible text.
